title: REDEFINES of an OCCURS — same bytes viewed as a structured array and as a flat byte buffer
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. RECORD-DUAL-VIEW.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
      *> WS-DETAILS holds 5 elementary records (10 bytes each).
      *> WS-DETAILS-BUF REDEFINES it as a flat 50-byte buffer for
      *> low-level copying (e.g. CICS COMMAREA shuffling). Both
      *> names address the same 50 bytes.
       01  WS-RECORD.
           05  WS-DETAILS OCCURS 5 TIMES.
               10  WS-CODE   PIC X(4).
               10  WS-VAL    PIC 9(6).
           05  WS-DETAILS-BUF REDEFINES WS-DETAILS PIC X(50).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           STOP RUN.
notes: REDEFINES of an OCCURS pattern is heavily used in CICS COMMAREA shuffling and inter-program byte-blob passing. A Java rewrite usually needs a ByteBuffer view PLUS a typed structure. Surface this so the migration preserves both views.
